== Destiny correction ==
The destiny number for [[Yoda, Jedi Master (Reflections Gold Remastered)|Yoda, Jedi Master]] was corrected from 2 to 1 to match the [[:File:RG-C1-Yoda-Jedi-Master.jpg|original playtest scan]]. The rest of the image is unchanged.
